static_traits.name: Chen Jing
static_traits.social_status: Weak Social support system, lacking someone to discuss incompetence and self-blame with
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological issues previously, not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, good logic, high cooperation, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Persistent feelings of incompetence and self-blame in competitive situations, worsened after the recent team loss at a video game expo.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop always feeling frustrated with myself and enjoy things again.
growth_experiences: Recently endured high pressure and ultimate loss in a team competition at a video game expo, attributing the failure to my own inadequate ability, triggering persistent incompetence and self-blame; afterward performed poorly again in community team sports, repeating the 'It is all my fault' self-attribution pattern, deepening shame and Anxiety; also lacking strong Social support, hard to confide in others and gain emotional buffering.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: In a team event at a video game expo, the team losing under high pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is not perfect enough, the team will fail; failure means I am very incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practice doubly hard after matches, strive to improve skill and performance to prove myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We lost because I am bad; I let everyone down

special_situations.event: The team performed poorly in community team sports
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as my teammates, it proves I am not competent, worse than others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-criticism, and plan to train even harder to make up for inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others, I am just not good enough

special_situations.event: In any competitive activity (video games or team matches)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail once, it means I am a failure overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced enjoyment of interest activities, avoiding participation or over-practicing to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not winning this time proves I am not capable

special_situations.event: During the match the team overall performed poorly with external factors at play
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must take full responsibility for the result; if not, I am shirking responsibility
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes all responsibility onto oneself, trying to avoid failing again through control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Losing the game was entirely because of me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable competitor and to be accepted and respected by the team
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated, being blamed for failure, disappointing others
defense_goal: Through preemptive self-blame and taking excessive responsibility, reduces the risk of external criticism
Maintains safety and self-worth through perfect performance

object_relations.self_representation: A disappointing failure/a not-good-enough team member
An insecure person who needs to constantly prove themselves
object_relations.object_representation: Stronger, more outstanding others who need to be catered to

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing a lost competition in counseling or being asked about personal performance and responsibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously understanding the counselor's inquiries as others' scrutiny and judgment of their own ability, worrying about being blamed as the cause of failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to respond with self-blaming language, proactively takes excessive responsibility, cautious tone, lowers self-worth, and weakens other or situational factors

manifestations: Lack a strong Social support system, hard to discuss incompetence and self-blame with others
Bear shame and Anxiety alone after competitive failure
outcomes: Anxiety and bodily tension (tight stomach, whole-body tension)

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: use'I should practice more''I must perform better' and similar self-Demands
Treats winning and losing as external standards that must be met and internalizes them as self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame ('It is all my fault')
Overly harsh on oneself when exploring one's own performance, hard to acknowledge situational and team factors

exception_events.target_problem: In Competitive activities, the client usually attributes failure entirely to themselves, sinking into shame and Anxiety, thus enjoying the activities less and avoiding participation
exception_events.unique_outcome: During parts of the video game expo, she did not just blame herself, but focused on participating, interacted with others and enjoyed the process; she learned teamwork and stress management, experiencing some fun
exception_events.reason: Clues: when building positive interactions with teammates and participants, focusing on Learning and cooperation, attention shifts from self-judgment to the process experience; the on-site social and Learning opportunities also provided support, easing self-blame and Anxiety for a time

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to invest in change (says he is 'ready to put in the effort')
Able to identify and Reflection automatic thoughts and cognitive patterns (able to list evidence and reframe views in conversation)
Willing to seek professional help and monitor progress
Has the ability to extract experience and meaning from failure (can see the gains in teamwork and stress management)
negative_force: Self-labeling and overgeneralization (believing 'I am a terrible competitor')
Over-personalization, blaming team failure on oneself
Lacks social support, bears pressure and self-blame alone
Shame and Anxiety accompanied by obvious bodily tension reactions

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-blame and Self-denial in competitive situations, accompanied by Anxiety and shame
antecedent: Participates in competitive activities such as video game exhibitions or team sports
High pressure during the match, the team overall performed poorly or external factors arose
target_behavior.core_reason: Formed the 'I am incompetent' core belief and cognitive distortions (personalization, overgeneralization, comparison and despair), and against the background of Weak social support attribute failure wholly inwardly to myself
target_behavior.function: Gain perceived control over outcomes through self-blame and drive self overtraining (trying to avoid future failures), while avoiding facing others' possible criticism and complex emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Activity enjoyment declining, Anxiety and shame and bodily tension arise, further affecting daily life and hobbies
